paragraphs.text: What is a membership website? It is a website where some content, tools or services are available only to people who sign up, usually for a fee. Members log in to read articles, download resources, watch videos, join discussions, access discounts or book member-only events. Visitors who are not logged in see a preview and an invitation to join.
Membership website development brings together several parts: sign-up and login, membership levels, payments, access rules, member profiles, email notifications and an admin area for your team.

sections.h2: How Do Membership Sites Make Money?
sections.intro: How do membership sites make money? Most use one or more of these models:

items.html: Recurring subscriptions: members pay monthly or yearly for ongoing access.
Tiered plans: basic, standard and premium levels unlock more content or services.
One-time lifetime access: a single payment for permanent membership.
Free plus paid: free members get limited access, and paid members unlock everything.
Sponsorships and member discounts: partners pay to reach a defined, engaged audience.

outro.text: A well-planned paid membership site earns predictable income each month, which is easier to plan around than one-off sales.

sections.h2: What Membership Website Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Subscription Website Development
items.text: Subscription website development covers sign-up flows, plan selection, trials, upgrades, downgrades and cancellations. A membership site with recurring payments charges members automatically on each renewal date, with receipts sent by email.

items.title: Recurring Billing Setup
items.html: Our recurring billing setup connects your site to Indian and international payment providers that support subscriptions, cards, UPI mandates and international currencies. Failed payments trigger polite reminders and retry rules, so fewer members drop off by accident.

items.title: Membership Levels and Access Control
items.text: Membership levels and access control decide exactly which pages, downloads, videos and features each plan can see. Content can be released over time, for example one module per week, and members can be moved between levels automatically or by your team.

items.title: Gated Content Website
items.text: A gated content website shows a short preview of each article, report or video, then asks visitors to join or log in to continue. It turns your best content into a reason to sign up, rather than giving everything away.

items.title: Members-Only Website Areas
items.text: A members-only website area gives each member a personal dashboard with their plan, renewal date, invoices, saved content and profile. Members can update details and download receipts without contacting your team.

items.title: Membership Renewal Automation
items.text: Membership renewal automation sends reminders before renewal, thank-you messages after payment and win-back emails when a membership lapses. Your team sees upcoming renewals and at-risk members at a glance.

items.title: Association Membership Website
items.text: An association membership website serves professional bodies, chambers of commerce, alumni groups and clubs. It handles annual fees, member directories, event registration, certificates and member-only notices.

items.title: Community Membership Platform
items.text: A community membership platform brings members together through discussion areas, groups, events and private messaging. It suits coaches, creators, interest groups and professional communities that want their own space instead of relying on social media.

paragraphs.html: Other common projects include premium content and research libraries, partner and dealer resource portals, and member benefit programmes for clubs and wellness centres. For structured courses with lessons, quizzes and certificates, see our online course platform page.

sections.h2: Membership Website vs Online Course Platform

paragraphs.text: Membership website vs online course platform comes down to what members are paying for. A membership site sells ongoing access to content, community, resources or benefits. An online course platform sells structured learning with lessons, progress tracking, quizzes and certificates. Many businesses combine both, and we plan the right mix during discovery.

paragraphs.html: MemberPress vs custom membership site is a common choice. MemberPress is a popular WordPress plugin that adds membership features quickly and suits standard membership models on a WordPress site. A custom membership site suits unusual pricing rules, large member numbers, deep integrations or apps alongside the website. We recommend the lighter option whenever it meets your needs, because it is faster and cheaper to launch.

paragraphs.text: Membership website security protects member data and paid content. We use encrypted connections, secure password storage, optional two-step login, role-based admin access, rate limits on login attempts and regular updates. Payments are handled by certified payment providers, so card details never touch your server. Paid files and videos are protected so they cannot be shared through direct links.

sections.h2: How Much Does a Membership Website Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does a membership website cost in India? It depends on the number of membership levels, payment and renewal rules, community features, integrations and member numbers. A plugin-based site costs far less than a custom platform with apps and complex billing.

Every project is quoted after discovery, and the quote is fixed for the agreed scope. Each quote for membership website development lists exactly what is included, including payment provider and hosting recommendations.

items.q: How long does membership website development take?
items.a: A standard membership site usually takes 4 to 6 weeks of membership website development. A custom platform with community features or complex billing takes 8 to 12 weeks. We confirm the timeline in writing after discovery.

items.q: Can we move existing members to a new membership site?
items.a: Yes. We import member records, plans and renewal dates from spreadsheets or your current system, then invite members to set a new password. Active subscriptions are moved carefully with your payment provider, so nobody is charged twice or loses access.

items.q: Can members manage their own plans?
items.a: Yes. Members can upgrade, downgrade, pause or cancel from their dashboard, within the rules you set. Every change updates billing automatically and is logged for your team.

items.q: What should we plan before building a membership site?
items.a: Decide who your members are, what they will pay for, which plans you will offer and how often content or benefits will be added. Clear answers here make the build faster and help the site keep members long term.
